{{Short description|German author, missionary, physicist and director}}
[[File:Dr Detlef Blöcher im September 2014.jpg|thumb|Blöcher in September 2014]]
'''Detlef Blöcher''' (born 15 January 1953 in [[Frankfurt|Frankfurt am Main]]) has been Director of the Christian Relief and Missionary Work [[DMG interpersonal]] in [[Sinsheim]] near [[Heidelberg]] from 2000 to May 2018. In the years before he worked as a lecturer in the Arab world and as human resources manager for the DMG. He is the author of several international studies and numerous specialist articles.<ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. Detlef Blöcher feiert 60. Geburtstag Artikel über seine Vita|url=http://www.ead.de/nachrichten/nachrichten/einzelansicht/article/dr-detlef-bloecher-feiert-60-geburtstag.html|access-date=2014-10-14|language=de}}
</ref>

== Biography ==
The [[Doctorate|promoted]] physicist worked in medical research and teaching in Germany, later in his specialty in [[Cancer|cancer research]] and as a lecturer in the Middle East. In 1991 he became human resources manager at DMG. In 2000, he took over the management of Manfred A. Bluthardt.

Since 1996 Detlef Blöcher is also an associate of the [[World Evangelical Alliance]] (WEA), on whose behalf he has directed several missiological research projects. In this context specialized articles about the studies REMAP I and REMAP II, dealing with the methods, effectiveness and limitations of modern [[Christian mission]] work, have been published.<ref>{{cite web|title=ReMAP II Launched in London|date=23 October 2002 |url=https://www.worldea.org/news/106/ReMAP-II-Launched-in-London|access-date=2014-10-14|language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Too Valuable to Lose, Exploring the Causes and Cures of Missionary Attrition|url=https://www.worldevangelicals.org/resources/view.htm?id=168|access-date=2014-10-14|language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Research Papers verfügbar in der englischsprachigen Website der DMG|url=https://www.dmgint.de/mission-en/research-papers.html|access-date=2014-10-14|language=de|archive-date=2016-03-04|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304185822/https://www.dmgint.de/mission-en/research-papers.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> In addition Blöcher is an expert on Christian missions and development aid and has published numerous specialist articles in Christian journals such as the magazine [[Entscheidung]] and [[idea spectrum]].

Since 2004 Blöcher has also been active as chairman of the "Arbeitsgemeinschaft Evangelikaler Missionen" (AEM, Arbeitsgemeinschaft Evangelical Missions).<ref>{{cite web|title=AEM e.V. Miteinander für die Welt|url=https://www.aem.de/verband/vorstand/|access-date=2014-10-14|language=de}}
</ref>
